emma: Heads-up: planning a coordinated canary publish for Python & TS SDKs tonight in the 22:00-23:00 UTC change window. Need version pins, rollback plan, and release-note stub before we kick. @liam can you own the pip/npm publish step?
liam: I can. What's the canary tag and which packages exactly? Also confirm we pin docs to the canary.
emma: Canary tag: `canary-2026-03-20`. Targets: `redwood-sdk` (py), `@redwood/sdk` (npm). We'll publish both under that tag and then promote to `latest` after smoke tests. Docs: set docs to point at `canary-2026-03-20` in quickstart until promote.
liam: Copy. I'll publish via CI job `ci/publish-sdk-canary`. If anything fails we should have a one-click revert. What's the revert sequence?
noah: Revert plan (short): 1) unpublish canary from npm/pypi (if published), 2) roll package index back (npm dist-tag rm / pipy yanking), 3) revert release-note and docs quickstart to previous pin, 4) redeploy gateway rollback config if behavioral regressions.
emma: Concrete commands:
```
# npm: remove canary tag
npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk canary-2026-03-20 || true
# or unpublish (if needed)
npm unpublish @redwood/sdk@1.5.0-canary-20260320 --force
# pip: yank (twine doesn't support yank) - we'll upload a new yanked metadata or mark in our index
# promote to latest
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.5.0 canary-2026-03-20
pip install redwood-sdk==1.5.0rc1  # for test pin
```
liam: Ok thanks. I added an emergency shortcut in the release job to call `scripts/unpublish-canary.sh`. I'll test it in staging now.
sophia: I'll draft a short release-note blurb and deprecation note for the legacy sync client. Proposed deprecation text: "Legacy sync client (v0.x) will be deprecated on 2026-06-01; please migrate to the async-first clients. Migration guide: /docs/migrate-sync-to-async". Thoughts?
noah: Add a code snippet showing `pip install redwood-sdk==>=1.5.0` and `npm i @redwood/sdk@^1.5.0`. Also mention breaking changes if any (token handling).
emma: Good call. We'll include a short breaking-changes section. I'll own final notes. @deploy-bot can you start the canary publish in 10m?
deploy-bot: [CI] Triggered job `ci/publish-sdk-canary` by liam. Job: 987654. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/987654 :building:
deploy-bot: [CI] Step 3/6: npm publish (canary). stdout: "Published @redwood/sdk@1.5.0-canary-20260320"
deploy-bot: [CI] Step 4/6: twine upload (pypi). stdout: "Uploading redwood_sdk-1.5.0rc1.tar.gz"
noah: Seeing a flakiness in TS bundle tests in staging - sourcemap path mismatch. I'm going to hold promote until we confirm.
liam: Smoke tests show basic generate/chat/embeddings passing. sourcemap issue is cosmetic but could affect source map-based error grouping. recommend hold promotion but proceed with publish as canary.
emma: Agreed. We'll keep canary published but block `dist-tag promote` to latest until we fix. Documenting mitigation: if we see SDK errors in prod we will yank canary and revert docs.
sophia: Drafted release-note draft in #docs-drafts with the deprecation blurb and migration link. Added manual QA checklist.
liam: Tested emergency unpublish script in a dry-run. Output looks good. Command to run if we need rollback now: `./scripts/unpublish-canary.sh --npm --pypi --tag canary-2026-03-20`.
noah: I manually triggered the staging smoke `ci/smoke-sdk` and everything passed except sourcemap test. Filing a small follow-up ticket: TRACK-412.
emma: Final: canary stays up, no promote. liam will hold the promote button. @sophia send the release-note PR targeting `release-notes/drafts` and mark for review. If any client error appears in next 2 hours, call rollback sequence. :warning:
liam: Acknowledged. I'll hold the promotion flag and keep the rollback shortcut ready. :thumbsup:
sophia: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pulls/58 — includes deprecation text, migration link, and code snippets.
deploy-bot: [CI] Job 987654 finished: SUCCESS :white_check_mark:
noah: Great. Keeping an eye on error groups. Ping me if any uptick.
emma: Thanks team. We'll revisit in the morning for final promote once TRACK-412 is fixed. Closing thread for now. :lock:
